method: A bounded curated discovery pass over 40 SemiAnalysis articles and 15 independent primary-source starting points. Sources are mapped many-to-many to domain IDs for curriculum research, not certified as complete coverage or sources of truth. The additional SA11–SA40 sample used 16 search queries and selected entries from the publisher's 2023–2026 annual sitemaps; research/discovery-searches.md records the method and limits. page_reviewed means the stated web page was inspected, with partial-reading and linked-document limits recorded in caution; public_excerpt_reviewed includes accessible previews, abstracts or selected public sections and never implies review of a complete paid work. candidate_not_reviewed means substantive content has not been reviewed. A domain mapping identifies intended research use, not verified support for every objective or claim. reviewed_on is the review date; published_on, where present, is the source's displayed publication date and is null when not established.

sources.title: OpenAI: Five new Stargate sites
sources.use: The article distinguishes a multi-site planned capacity total from its statement about early workloads at Abilene.
sources.caution: Main article and visible October 22, 2025 update inspected on September 6, 2026. This lesson audits the dated statements; it does not establish current operating MW, complete topology or site economics.

sources.title: GPU Performance Background User’s Guide
sources.use: A GPU combines execution resources and a memory hierarchy; achieved performance depends on workload behavior.
sources.caution: Use conceptual structure only; dated product examples and throughput tables are not applied.

sources.title: Matrix Multiplication Background User’s Guide
sources.use: Matrix shape and reuse can alter arithmetic intensity and the active performance limit.
sources.caution: A guide to particular operations, not a universal model of end-to-end AI job performance.

sources.title: NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD — Network Fabrics
sources.use: A named reference system distinguishes compute, storage and management fabrics and explicit topology groupings.
sources.caution: H100 reference architecture updated November 19, 2025; no component counts or ratios are generalized.

sources.title: NCCL Collective Operations
sources.use: Defines collective transformations and participation requirements.
sources.caution: Inspected NCCL 2.31.2 documentation; the ring timing model is original and is not asserted to be the library’s chosen implementation.

sources.title: Scaling AI Factories with Co-Packaged Optics for Better Power Efficiency
sources.use: Describes moving optical conversion nearer switch silicon and the associated electrical-path mechanism.
sources.caution: August 18, 2025 vendor account; availability and benefit claims are dated proposals, not universal deployment evidence.

sources.title: NVIDIA Optical Transceivers and Cables
sources.use: Provides distinct interconnect product categories whose compatibility must be checked at the actual interface.
sources.caution: Product catalog and marketing page; no power, reach or reliability rating is adopted without its specific datasheet.

sources.title: NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD — Storage Architecture
sources.use: Storage requirements vary with data format, cache behavior, workload and checkpoint traffic.
sources.caution: H100 reference guidance updated November 19, 2025; its numerical sizing recommendations are not imported.

sources.title: PyTorch Distributed Checkpoint
sources.use: A distributed checkpoint coordinates application state across participants and storage writers.
sources.caution: Public indexed API excerpts reviewed; the directly opened stable URL returned a redirect shell. Pin and review the selected framework release and storage writer before implementation; no complete API audit is claimed.

sources.title: Asynchronous Saving with Distributed Checkpoint
sources.use: Asynchronous saving requires staged state, host-memory capacity and management of concurrent save requests.
sources.caution: Tutorial updated February 3, 2026; APIs are version-sensitive. No tutorial benchmark is generalized.

sources.title: Control Group in Slurm
sources.use: Process tracking, accounting and resource confinement have distinct roles.
sources.caution: Current documentation includes version-specific behavior; no live configuration changes are prescribed.

sources.title: NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD — Software
sources.use: A reference cluster includes orchestration, system management, libraries and operating-system components.
sources.caution: Vendor reference stack, updated November 19, 2025; it does not certify an arbitrary tenant environment.

sources.title: ASHRAE — Emergence and Expansion of Liquid Cooling in Mainstream Data Centers
sources.use: Thermal resistance connects device temperature, cooling-medium temperature and device heat; local requirements can drive cooling changes.
sources.caution: Selected thermal-resistance discussion reviewed from the 2021 white paper. No historical trend figure or vendor temperature class is reproduced.

sources.title: Open Compute Project — Cold Plate workstream
sources.use: The workstream separates cold-plate, loop, fluid and connector requirements.
sources.caution: Index reviewed; linked loop-requirement PDF did not load during this pass and is not treated as audited.

sources.title: Eaton — Rack Basics: Selection, Installation and Cooling
sources.use: EIA 19-inch mounting terminology, 1.75-inch rack units, usable U height versus external cabinet height, and separate depth and load considerations.
sources.caution: Reviewed indexed public text under Rack Standards, Rack Units, Height, Width and Depth; direct page retrieval returned 403. Manufacturer explainer, not a review of the full EIA standard. Product-independent classroom allocation is original; no universal AI-rack compatibility or advertised cooling savings are adopted.

sources.title: Open Compute Project — Open Rack V3 Base Specification, revision 1.0
sources.use: Sections 6, 6.1.2 and 6.1.3 distinguish 48 mm OpenU spacing from optional 44.45 mm EIA rack-unit support and allow exterior frame dimensions to vary.
sources.caution: Reviewed the public PDF mechanical sections on printed pages 7, 9 and 11, plus revision table on page 6. Revision 1.0 is the identified reference, not a claim to the latest revision. Electrical, connector and qualification requirements were not audited; the lesson does not infer interchangeability from height alone.

sources.title: Schneider Electric — PM2200 total power calculation for accuracy verification
sources.use: The selected PM2200 manual page gives balanced three-phase real power as 3 × line-to-neutral voltage × current × power factor. The course uses the equivalent line-to-line form with RMS voltage and current.
sources.caution: Reviewed only the linked calculation page, not the whole PM2200 manual. Its balanced three-phase formula supports the electrical relationship, not data-center topology, cable sizing, converter efficiency or any claimed measured savings. Numerical course examples are original calculations.
sources.discovered_via: 480 V AC versus 800 V DC teaching sample correction, 2026-09-08.

sources.title: NVIDIA, Partners Drive Next-Gen Efficient Gigawatt AI Factories in Buildup for Vera Rubin
sources.use: The introductory discussion and Kyber section explicitly identify 415 or 480 V AC three-phase distribution as baselines for the proposed move to 800 V DC. This supports the relevance of the course comparison.
sources.caution: Used to identify the AC distribution baseline, not to validate vendor efficiency, current, copper, capacity or deployment claims. The page contains later branding edits. All sample loads, resistance values and converter losses remain original teaching assumptions.
sources.discovered_via: Primary-source verification of 480 V AC baseline relevance, 2026-09-08.
